activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
Packing work bag, checking phone for shift messages and tidying up
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break in the staff room
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, handover notes and coordinating with the care team
Cooking and eating dinner, loading the dishwasher afterwards
Washing up and changing into comfortable clothes
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Using the computer for online continuing education and reviewing the next day's roster
